rows.note: For a friendly, kindly manner, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: They warmly welcomed me into their home.
example.jyutping: keoi5 can1 cit3 gam2 ziu1 fu1 ngo5 jap6 uk1

rows.note: Choose this when the friendliness is especially enthusiastic or welcoming rather than simply kindly.

example.english: The restaurant owner warmly welcomed us.
example.traditional: 餐廳老闆熱情咁招呼我哋。
example.jyutping: caan1 teng1 lou5 baan2 jit6 cing4 gam2 ziu1 fu1 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this when telling someone to dress or act so as to stay warmer.

example.english: Dress more warmly when you go out.
example.jyutping: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 zyu6 zoek3 dak1 nyun5 di1
